message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, missing) across all sides. A commonly cited breakdown is:

| Side | Casualties (approx.) |
|------|----------------------|
| French & allied (Napoleon’s forces) | 25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch, Prussian, and other Allied forces | 22,000 |

These figures are estimates based on contemporary reports and later historical analyses; exact numbers vary slightly among sources. The battle was one of the bloodiest single-day engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.
